clips.title: The story
paras: Mages in the Undercity keep the Chest of Containment Coffers close at hand. Its enchanted vessels can secure unstable magical phenomena.

Invisible arcane creatures can emerge from experiments or sudden rifts between planes. Ordinary cages cannot hold beings made of magic. The Chest of Containment Coffers holds enchanted vessels that bind subdued creatures alive. Senior instructors keep the chest nearby, including Anastasia Hartwell in the Undercity and Jennea Cannon in Stormwind. They give initiates the coffers for surveying anomalies before those forces can unsettle their surroundings.
